description: Admin UI page for managing mcp_exemptions records. Serves on port 8790. Fetches rows via write_service query endpoint, renders table with columns: mcp_server_id, mcp_name, granted_by, granted_at, valid_until, reason. Includes Revoke and Extend action buttons that POST to approval_workflow via write_service. Embedded CSS for table styling. Refresh mechanism via meta http-equiv. Read mcp_exemptions table schema from DB_SCHEMA.md for column names.
